_doc: Reel Reads library: every book a professor recommended to Arthur or he captured via Ambidex, plus the films, TV series and documentaries he captured to watch (field `type`: book | film | series | documentary; missing = book; screen items carry `creator` instead of `author`). Books stay the core of the swipe feed, growing until release. One entry per book. status: 'seed' = in the v1 feed (Docs/Reel Reads Specifications.md, Seed catalogue), 'queued' = in the library, no cards yet, 'carded' = cards generated. Only add a book with a traceable source (course, session, or Arthur's own capture). Never atomise a course's Primary readings with AI where the course bans it (Massey OIDD/LGST 6930 does). Add entries with library/add.py (dedupes by title and type).

books.title: The Alabama Solution
books.creator: Andrew Jarecki, Charlotte Kaufman
books.note: HBO documentary built on footage filmed by men inside Alabama's prisons on smuggled phones: violence, deaths in custody and forced labour. HBO Max in the US.

books.title: Tip Toe
books.creator: Russell T Davies
books.note: Russell T Davies thriller: two neighbours become enemies as online anti-LGBTQ hate escalates. About anti-woke hostility, not anti-woke itself. Starz in the US, Channel 4 in the UK.

books.title: Years and Years
books.creator: Russell T Davies
books.note: One Manchester family across 15 years of political, tech and climate upheaval; Emma Thompson as a populist. Six hour-long episodes, HBO Max.

books.title: Furious
books.creator: Elizabeth Meriwether
books.source: Ambidex capture T-0138, 01/11/2026 (Hulu show, ~80% the one meant)
books.note: Emmy Rossum as an FBI agent hunting a serial killer, from Elizabeth Meriwether. Eight episodes on Hulu (about 80% sure this is the one you meant).

books.title: Russian Doll
books.creator: Natasha Lyonne, Leslye Headland, Amy Poehler
books.note: Natasha Lyonne keeps dying and restarting the same night in New York. Two short seasons on Netflix; season 1 stands alone.

books.title: Poker Face
books.creator: Rian Johnson
books.note: Rian Johnson mystery: Natasha Lyonne can always tell when someone is lying, one case per episode. Peacock. The "bullshitting series".

books.title: Caniba
books.creator: Véréna Paravel, Lucien Castaing-Taylor
books.note: Art-house documentary on Issei Sagawa, who killed and cannibalised a fellow student in Paris in 1981 and was never tried. Graphic and slow.

books.title: Westworld
books.creator: Jonathan Nolan, Lisa Joy
books.note: HBO: a theme park of android hosts who start to become self-aware. A pop-culture frame for agent autonomy and alignment.
